using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace Showcase.BlazorClient;

public static class BookingClientExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers <see cref="IBookingClient"/> against <paramref name="baseUrl"/>.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection.</param>
    /// <param name="baseUrl">Base address of the API.</param>
    /// <param name="configure">Optional additional configuration of the underlying HttpClient.</param>
    public static IServiceCollection AddBookingClient(this IServiceCollection services, 
                                                      string baseUrl, 
                                                      Action<HttpClient>? configure = null)
    {
        services.AddHttpClient<IBookingClient, BookingHttpClient>(client =>
        {
            client.BaseAddress = new Uri(baseUrl);
            configure?.Invoke(client);
        });
        return services;
    }
    
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using Pragmatic;
using Pragmatic.Client;

namespace Showcase.BlazorClient;

internal sealed class BookingHttpClient : IBookingClient
{
    private readonly HttpClient _http;
    public BookingHttpClient(HttpClient http) => _http = http;

    public async Task<Pragmatic.Result.Result<System.Guid, Pragmatic.Result.IError>> CreateGuest(CreateGuestRequest request, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var url = "/api/v1/guests";
        var response = await _http.PostAsJsonAsync(url, request, Info<CreateGuestRequest>(), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            var payload = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync(Info<System.Guid>(), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            return payload;
        }

        return Pragmatic.Result.Result<System.Guid, Pragmatic.Result.IError>.Failure(await MapErrorAsync(response, ct).ConfigureAwait(false));
    }

    public async Task<Pragmatic.Result.Result<GuestDto, Pragmatic.Result.IError>> GetGuest(System.Guid id, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var url = $"/api/v1/guests/{System.Uri.EscapeDataString(id.ToString()!)}";
        var response = await _http.GetAsync(url, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            var payload = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync(Info<GuestDto>(), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (payload is null)
                return Pragmatic.Result.Result<GuestDto, Pragmatic.Result.IError>.Failure(
                    new ApiError { Code = "EMPTY_RESPONSE", Title = "The server returned a success status with no body.", StatusCode = (int)response.StatusCode });
            return payload;
        }

        return Pragmatic.Result.Result<GuestDto, Pragmatic.Result.IError>.Failure(await MapErrorAsync(response, ct).ConfigureAwait(false));
    }

    public async Task<Pragmatic.Result.VoidResult<Pragmatic.Result.IError>> DeleteGuest(System.Guid id, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var url = $"/api/v1/guests/{System.Uri.EscapeDataString(id.ToString()!)}";
        var response = await _http.DeleteAsync(url, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode) return Pragmatic.Result.VoidResult<Pragmatic.Result.IError>.Success();
        return Pragmatic.Result.VoidResult<Pragmatic.Result.IError>.Failure(await MapErrorAsync(response, ct).ConfigureAwait(false));
    }

    /// <summary>Metadata for a type this client puts on the wire.</summary>
    private static System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata.JsonTypeInfo<T> Info<T>()
        => Showcase.BlazorClient.Generated.PragmaticJsonContext.Default.GetTypeInfo(typeof(T))
               as System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata.JsonTypeInfo<T>
           ?? throw new System.InvalidOperationException(
               $"The generated client context does not cover '{typeof(T)}'. This is a generator bug: " +
               "every type an endpoint sends or reads should be in it.");

    private static async Task<Pragmatic.Result.IError> MapErrorAsync(HttpResponseMessage response, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var statusCode = (int)response.StatusCode;
        string? code = null;
        string? title = null;
        string? detail = null;
        JsonElement root = default;
        var body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        try
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(body))
            {
                using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
                root = doc.RootElement.Clone();
                if (root.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
                {
                    if (root.TryGetProperty("code", out var codeProp))
                        code = codeProp.GetString();
                    if (root.TryGetProperty("title", out var titleProp))
                        title = titleProp.GetString();
                    if (root.TryGetProperty("detail", out var detailProp))
                        detail = detailProp.GetString();
                }
            }
        }
        catch (JsonException ex)
        {
            detail = "The error response was not valid JSON (" + ex.Message + "). Body: " +
                (body.Length > 512 ? body.Substring(0, 512) + "…" : body);
        }

        return code switch
        {
            "CONFLICT" => new ConflictError(),
            _ => new ApiError { Code = code ?? "UNKNOWN", Title = title ?? "Request failed", StatusCode = statusCode, Detail = detail }
        };
    }
}

/// <summary>

public sealed class PagedResult<T>
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The items in the current page.
    /// </summary>
    public T[] Items { get; set; } = [];
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Total item count across all pages.
    /// </summary>
    public int TotalCount { get; set; }

    /// Current page (1-based).
    /// </summary>
    public int Page { get; set; }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Page size.
    /// </summary>
    public int PageSize { get; set; }
}
